shots.narration: Your customer puts a shoe on the work surface.
shots.prompt: Image 1 is the fixed empty workshop, image 2 the olive-coated leatherworker, image 3 the teal-coated customer. Same shop camera, medium shot of the front counter. The customer stands OUTSIDE the counter on its street side and sets ONE worn dark-brown low shoe down with a pure-white mitten hand. The leatherworker stands BEHIND the counter beside its stool, leaning forward to inspect. The worn shoe has a loosened join between upper and sole along its outer side, still ONE attached object, not two shoes. Keep the master left rack, all folded leather and its two existing shoe pairs, rear door and jar, right bench with tools and jug, hanging leather and canopy fixed. Worker exact olive outer coat, burgundy inner garment, rust sash and dark covered lower body; customer exact teal coat, ochre inner garment, grey sash. Not a baker and no bread. Sober BD crisp outlines, flat matte colours, low texture, simple garment shadows. Both substantial adults have perfectly round oversized pure #FFFFFF heads, small black dot eyes and tiny straight neutral mouths, no nose, ears, hair or brows. ALL exposed skin #FFFFFF without grey shadows, white mitten hands without detailed fingers, covered bodies. No text or extra people.
